# Sodium Boost
**Sodium Boost** delivers an elite, performance-driven environment tailored specifically for purists who want to eliminate in-game lag while fully preserving the classic Minecraft feel. 

By integrating a hand-picked selection of top-tier rendering and system optimization modules, this profile dramatically accelerates frame rates and stabilizes performance—providing a flawlessly fluid experience across both budget desktop setups and mobile devices.

## Features

* 🚀 **Uncapped Frame Rates:** Experience a monumental jump in FPS, unlocking the true potential of your hardware compared to the default client.
* 🔒 **Flawless Vanilla Parity:** Strictly preserves the core mechanics of the game. Enjoy smooth performance with absolutely zero gameplay modifications.
* ✨ **Next-Gen Visual Ready:** Built-in modern shader architecture support, allowing high-end lighting modifications to run with minimal hardware overhead.
* 🧠 **Smart Memory Caching:** Intelligently stabilizes hardware resources to prevent sudden game stutters and heavy memory degradation during long play sessions.
* 🪶 **Streamlined Core Build:** A highly calculated layout containing only essential, non-intrusive modules to eliminate background clutter.

## Getting Started

1. **Open Your Launcher:** Launch the Modrinth App (or your preferred custom application launcher).
2. **Search for the Pack:** Go to the search bar and look up **"Sodium Boost"**.
3. **Install & Play:** Click the install button to instantly deploy the profile. It is completely pre-configured and ready for a seamless, pure plug-and-play experience!
